digest.lead: Claude.ai experienced a significant outage yesterday that sparked widespread discussion about reliability, while Anthropic announced new creative work features and joined Blender's development fund.
digest.summary: Claude Code received multiple updates including Bedrock service tier controls and improved PR integration, while the community debates Anthropic's approach to AI safety.

stories.headline: Claude.ai Suffers Major Outage with API Errors
stories.summary: Claude.ai became unavailable with elevated API errors yesterday [1], generating significant community discussion with 282 upvotes and 243 comments on Hacker News.
key_points: Service disruption affected both web interface and API endpoints
High community engagement suggests widespread impact on users
stories.impact: The outage likely disrupted daily workflows for developers and businesses relying on Claude for production applications, highlighting concerns about service reliability for enterprise users.

sources.title: Claude.ai unavailable and elevated errors on the API

stories.headline: Anthropic Launches New Creative Work Features for Claude
stories.summary: Anthropic announced Claude For Creative Work [1], introducing new capabilities designed to assist users with creative projects and workflows.
stories.impact: This expands Claude's appeal beyond technical use cases to creative professionals, potentially opening new market segments including writers, designers, and content creators.

stories.headline: Anthropic Updates Election Safety Measures
stories.summary: Anthropic released an update on election safeguards [1], detailing measures to ensure responsible AI behavior during election periods.
stories.impact: This addresses growing concerns about AI's role in political discourse and demonstrates Anthropic's commitment to preventing misuse during sensitive political periods.

stories.headline: Claude Code Adds Bedrock Service Tier Controls and PR Integration
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.122 introduced the `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER` environment variable for selecting Bedrock service tiers and improved PR URL handling in search [1]. A follow-up patch v2.1.123 fixed OAuth authentication issues when experimental betas are disabled [2].
key_points: New Bedrock service tier options: default, flex, or priority
Pasting PR URLs into /resume now finds the session that created the PR
Improved MCP connector visibility and duplicate detection
stories.impact: These updates give developers more control over Bedrock performance tiers and streamline PR-based workflows, particularly valuable for teams using Claude Code in continuous integration environments.

stories.headline: Anthropic Joins Blender Development Fund as Corporate Patron
stories.summary: Anthropic became a corporate patron of the Blender Development Fund [1], supporting the open-source 3D creation software with significant community interest shown by 248 upvotes and 198 comments on Hacker News.
stories.impact: This partnership signals Anthropic's commitment to supporting open-source creative tools and may lead to deeper integration between Claude and 3D modeling workflows, benefiting the creative technology community.

sources.title: Anthropic Joins the Blender Development Fund as Corporate Patron

stories.headline: Community Debates Anthropic's Narrow Definition of AI Safety
stories.summary: A critical analysis argues that Anthropic's definition of safety is too narrow [1], sparking community discussion about the company's approach to AI safety and alignment.
stories.perspectives: The critique suggests Anthropic focuses too heavily on certain safety aspects while potentially overlooking others, though the piece received limited engagement with only 23 upvotes and no comments.
stories.impact: This debate reflects ongoing tensions in the AI community about how companies should prioritize different aspects of AI safety, particularly relevant for researchers and ethicists working on AI alignment.

sources.title: Anthropic's definition of safety is too narrow

stories.headline: New Tool Enables Background macOS App Control Without Cursor Stealing
stories.summary: A developer released CUA, an open-source tool for driving macOS applications in the background without stealing cursor focus [1], generating interest with 91 upvotes and 28 comments on Hacker News.
stories.impact: This tool could be valuable for developers building automation workflows with Claude or other AI assistants that need to interact with multiple macOS applications simultaneously.

sources.title: Show HN: Drive any macOS app in the background without stealing the cursor

stories.headline: Set ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER to control AWS Bedrock performance
stories.summary: You can now configure which AWS Bedrock service tier Claude Code uses by setting an environment variable. This lets you choose between default performance, flexible pricing, or priority processing depending on your needs.
actionable_steps: Set the environment variable ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER to one of: 'default', 'flex', or 'priority'
Restart Claude Code to apply the new service tier setting
Verify the tier is active by checking that requests include the X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier header

stories.headline: Set up Google Vertex AI integration using the interactive wizard
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.98 introduced a guided setup wizard that simplifies connecting to Google Vertex AI. This eliminates manual configuration steps and reduces authentication errors by walking you through GCP setup, project selection, and credential verification.
actionable_steps: Open Claude Code and go to the login screen
Follow the interactive Google Vertex AI setup wizard
Complete GCP authentication, project and region configuration, and credential verification as prompted

stories.headline: Set CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 to eliminate screen flickering
stories.summary: This environment variable enables flicker-free alt-screen rendering with virtualized scrollback in Claude Code v2.1.88+. It provides a smoother visual experience when Claude Code switches between screen modes during long coding sessions.
actionable_steps: Add 'export CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1' to your shell profile (.bashrc, .zshrc, etc.)
Restart your terminal or run 'source ~/.bashrc' to apply the change
Launch Claude Code to verify flicker-free rendering is active

stories.headline: Use /powerup command to learn Claude Code features interactively
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.90 introduced the /powerup command that provides interactive lessons with animated demos to help you learn Claude Code features. This is particularly useful for new users who want to quickly understand the tool's capabilities through hands-on tutorials.
actionable_steps: Update Claude Code to version 2.1.90 or later
Type `/powerup` in the Claude Code interface
Follow the interactive lessons and animated demos to learn features

stories.headline: Use `/team-onboarding` command to generate teammate ramp-up guides
stories.summary: Claude Code can automatically create onboarding documentation for new team members based on your local usage patterns. This saves time creating training materials and ensures consistency in how team members learn your workflows.
actionable_steps: Update to Claude Code v2.1.101 or later
Run the `/team-onboarding` command in your Claude Code interface
Review the generated ramp-up guide and customize as needed
Share the guide with new team members
